calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_ids,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales' AS src, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines, SUM(quantity) AS units, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS l0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, SUM(units_sold), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), NULL, NULL
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.subcategory, units_sold, COALESCE(units_returned,0) AS units_returned, units_sold - COALESCE(units_returned,0) AS net_units
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (subcategory) ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 6
